title: Claude Code Python tracing, trace user attribution: resolve user from USER then USERNAME via _get_current_user
answers: Why is the user empty on Windows for Claude Code traces logged from Python?
Where is trace_user set when finalizing a Claude Code session?
How does the Claude Code autolog hook decide the user name?
Where is the working directory and user metadata written for a Claude Code trace?
body:
Path: Finalizes Claude Code sessions into MLflow traces on the Python side (mlflow autolog claude hook path). mlflow/claude_code/tracing.py:_finalize_trace writes the trace user and working-directory metadata onto each trace it builds.
Rule: Take the user from mlflow/claude_code/tracing.py:_get_current_user, which returns os.environ USER, then USERNAME, then ''. Use this helper rather than reading os.environ USER inline, so Windows hosts that only set USERNAME still get attribution.
Symptom: On Windows, Claude Code traces logged through the Python path carried an empty user, so attribution by user was missing.
Constraints: The helper reads environment variables only; it does not call getpass.getuser(). An empty result must not raise, and the trace is still finalized with an empty user value. tests/claude_code/test_tracing.py covers USERNAME fallback, USER precedence, and the empty case.
applies: Python Claude Code tracing in mlflow/claude_code/; the TypeScript integrations have their own helper.
says: User attribution is blank on activity traces recorded from Windows developer machines.
The user name field is empty when viewing recorded assistant sessions in the dashboard.
Ensure automated trace logging correctly identifies the logged in user on Windows workstations.
Why are working directory and user details missing from captured session traces?
search: Python Claude Code trace finalization resolves user attribution via mlflow/claude_code/tracing.py:_get_current_user by checking os.environ USER, falling back to USERNAME, and defaulting to an empty string. Used in mlflow/claude_code/tracing.py:_finalize_trace to record trace user and working-directory metadata, ensuring Windows hosts that only define USERNAME receive proper attribution. Applies to Python Claude Code tracing via the autolog hook path, whereas TypeScript integrations use a separate helper. The implementation inspects environment variables without calling getpass.getuser(), must not raise on empty values, and is tested in tests/claude_code/test_tracing.py.
